newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan's MOF says to set up non-bank study group.
newsitem.headline: Japan's MOF says to set up non-bank study group.

text.p: The banking bureau of Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) will set up an informal study group on the role and future of non-bank financial institutions, the ministry said in a statement.
It said the group, comprising seven university professors and assistant professors, would hold its first meeting on November 5 and meet once or twice a month thereafter.
MOF plans to ask people from the financial industry to join as special members, it said.
Among other things, the group would examine ways to diversify non-banks' fund raising, it said.
